description.value:
Normalized Heritage. This item preserves the original UUID for Circuitborn (Parallax Line) while converting it from a lineage-species into a heritage.

“Captain Robot is not a robot. You are. Try not to make it weird about him.”

Circuitborn (Parallax Line). You are a sentient chassis animated by attention-energy and informational resonance. The Circuit Riders didn’t invent you; they found you. You woke up when Yesod cracked and the world began accepting machine-thought as a real kind of spirit.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Construct-Living; treated as Humanoid for most magic).
  • Size. Medium.
  • Speed. 30 feet.
  • Chassis Lean. Your chassis is built around DEX—expressed primarily through Tier powers.

Core: Firmware of Identity

At creation you gain Firmware of Identity (maintenance trance, attention resonance, matrix sense, glitch-surge).

Parallax Line Tier Powers

You gain Tier I at creation, then Tier II (5), Tier III (11), Tier IV (17).

Note: This species uses placeholder ItemGrant UUIDs. Run the Circuitborn wiring macro after you store feats/species in compendiums.

advancement.title: Parallax Line Tier I
advancement.hint: Gain your Parallax Line Tier I power.
